approaches.title: Compare the minimum element with the minimum odd element
approaches.summary: Find the smallest odd value and the overall minimum. The array is considered constructible when they are equal, with an all-even array handled as a special case.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial implementation finds the smallest odd and overall minimum, but incorrectly accepts duplicate smallest odd values as a fallback.

revisions.commitComment: terminate early on first found pair
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 3876: terminate early on first found pair
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Keeps the same strategy while replacing a full duplicate count with early termination after finding a second matching odd value.

revisions.commitBody:
they had a fallback for when there were at least 2 of the same smallest
odd number thinking that they could subtract each other and form an even
0.

However, the constrains are nums[i] > nums[j]. So the two smallest odds
cannot cancel each other out
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Corrects the logic by removing the invalid duplicate-odd fallback, leaving only the minimum-value equality condition.
